root_cause_repairs.finding: The /cases runtime had no first-class blocked-case composition tied to one canonical blocked predicate; blocker truth, metrics, filters and row actions could diverge.
root_cause_repairs.repair: Added a blocked view driven by explicit blocked/on_hold status or active canonical owner-control blocker data, with shared dynamic metrics, disabled canonical status selection, real client/blocker options, blocked-age ordering and real row navigation/actions. Waiting-on-client remains excluded unless an explicit blocked/on_hold status is present.

root_cause_repairs.finding: The shared owner-control consumer could miss blocker variants nested under payload/data/metadata, treat a high priority as a blocker without missing-item context, or let a false blocking flag be overridden by inference.
root_cause_repairs.repair: Expanded the existing owner-control helper to inspect the canonical nested record views, recognize explicit missing/blocking markers, honor explicit false values, require missing context for priority-only inference, and preserve closed-status exclusion. No second blocker source was introduced.

root_cause_repairs.finding: Blocked timestamps could fall back to generic updated/created dates, making the ZABLOKOWANE OD column appear precise when no blocker timestamp existed; feed failure could also look like an empty healthy state.
root_cause_repairs.repair: Blocked age now uses only explicit blocked/status-change or canonical blocker creation timestamps, unknown dates sort last, and task-feed failures use Promise.allSettled with a visible blocked-only warning and retry action while preserving case data.

root_cause_repairs.finding: Blocked rows lacked a reference-shaped blocker/age/priority/action surface and the narrow production viewport could clip toolbar labels.
root_cause_repairs.repair: Derived blocker reason, blocked date, priority and suggested action from existing case/task data with safe fallbacks, exposed contact actions only when a real phone/email exists, preserved the detail action, and added a route-scoped two-column toolbar breakpoint at 1400 px so 1280 px remains readable while the wide table keeps intentional internal scrolling.
